text: Two-row Header 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的会话顶栏布局插件。它通过 DSH 客户端扩展点加载界面模块，并注入样式，将会话操作和工具安排到不同顶栏行，保留原有控件顺序；空间较窄时，控件还可以继续换行。适合希望会话标题栏更清晰、减少操作控件拥挤的 DSH 用户。插件代码没有配置 API 密钥或运行时外部服务。

Two-row Header is a DSH web client layout plugin. It places conversation actions and utilities on separate header rows, preserves their order, and lets controls wrap when space is limited. It suits users who want a clearer, less crowded conversation header.
把 DSH 会话顶栏里的操作和工具分成两行显示，避免挤在一起。
DSH 网页会话的标题栏按钮太拥挤，有没有办法整理布局？
Can I arrange the DSH conversation header actions and utilities on separate rows?
Two-row Header 的功能「会话顶栏分行」：将会话操作区放到第一行，把工具区和右侧角落控件排到第二行，并允许控件在空间不足时换行；通过 DSH 客户端 slot 注入界面样式。

dsh-two-row-header README · Two-row Header：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Place native conversation actions and utilities on separate header rows. Controls retain their original order and behavior and can wrap further when space is limited.

The plugin uses DSH extension points and leaves with its bundle when disabled. It adds no tools, model prompts, external requests, or conversation records.
